description: Local metadata record for the Patent Bar study-tool reference library. Tracks every source document's provenance, version, and checksum. The OED exam-source manifest (item authoritative_oed_source_list below) is the sole authority on what is currently examinable; USC/CFR entries are supporting/validation sources only and do not expand exam scope.

authoritative_oed_source_list.description: USPTO OED's own page listing the four documents that define registration-exam content. This is the controlling manifest for exam scope.
authoritative_oed_source_list.issuing_organization: USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED)
authoritative_oed_source_list.notes: Confirmed directly from this snapshot: exactly 4 documents currently define exam content (items EXAM-1 through EXAM-4 below). Also confirmed via web research that the USPTO's Sept 23, 2026 examination update does NOT change the tested MPEP edition -- both the pre- and post-update exams test MPEP Ninth Edition, Revision 01.2024. No MPEP version change is pending as of this manifest's retrieval date.

sources.source_name: Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP), Ninth Edition, Revision 01.2024
sources.issuing_organization: United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO)
sources.retrieval_date: 2025-08-18 (pre-existing acquisition, prior to this Phase 1 session -- see repo commit history a438ee0/627397f/a260259)
sources.notes: Already present in this repository prior to the Phase 1 acquisition session; reused via symlink rather than re-downloaded or duplicated, to avoid bloating repo size with a second ~59MB copy. Confirmed current against the live OED source-materials manifest as of 2026-09-03 -- no newer revision is being tested. Per Source Policy, this version must NOT be silently replaced even if a newer MPEP revision is later published; any future OED manifest change must be presented to the user before this is updated.

sources.issuing_organization: USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB)
sources.notes: URL matches exactly what the current OED manifest cites (November 2019). Verified 2026-09-03 via pdftotext in Codespace: page 1 header reads 'Consolidated Trial Practice Guide / November 2019' and 'TRIAL PRACTICE GUIDE / NOVEMBER 2019 EDITION' -- matches version/publication_date above exactly.

sources.source_name: Changes to Representation of Others Before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (Final Rule)
sources.issuing_organization: USPTO / Federal Register / Government Publishing Office
sources.notes: The OED manifest cites this document via a legacy gpo.gov/fdsys URL, which now 302-redirects to gpo.gov/fdsys/pkg/... ; govinfo.gov is GPO's current official host for the same Federal Register document (verified same FR citation/date) and was used as the actual download source. This is the final rule that adopted the USPTO Rules of Professional Conduct (37 CFR Part 11, Subpart B).

sources.source_name: Implementation of the Global and IP5 Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) Pilot Programs with Participating Offices
sources.version: as cited in current OED manifest (no separate revision number stated)
sources.notes: URL matches exactly what the current OED manifest cites. Verified 2026-09-03 via pdftotext/pdfinfo in Codespace: body text states the Global/IP5 PPH pilot programs 'commenced on January 6, 2014'; the PDF's embedded scan metadata (Adobe Paper Capture) shows CreationDate 2014-02-18, consistent with a notice published around that program launch. The document itself carries no printed issue date (signature block is a blank/illegible OCR field, signed by then-Deputy Director Michelle K. Lee) -- publication_date recorded as an approximation, not an exact printed date.

sources.source_name: General Requirements Bulletin for Admission to the Examination for Registration to Practice in Patent Cases Before the USPTO
sources.issuing_organization: USPTO Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED)
sources.notes: Administrative/eligibility document, not an exam-content source -- does not define what is examinable. Unlike the exam-defining sources, this document is expected to be periodically superseded by USPTO and should be re-checked/re-downloaded periodically rather than version-locked. Verified 2026-09-03 via pdftotext in Codespace: title page reads 'Issued August 2026', superseding the earlier (unconfirmed, web-search-derived) guess of a January 2025 edition -- the file on disk was downloaded 2026-09-03 and is the current August 2026 edition, so no re-download is needed right now.

sources.source_name: Official Prometric USPTO Registration Examination computer-delivered tutorial/demo
sources.version: n/a -- interactive tool, not a versioned document
sources.notes: Reference-only: this is an interactive third-party tool (blocks automated fetching, HTTP 403) rather than a static document, and is not appropriate to mirror/redistribute. Recorded here as a citation only. Its purpose in this project is to inform the practice-exam UI's navigation/mark-for-review mechanics (Phase 4/5) -- intended to be reviewed manually in a browser rather than downloaded.

sources.source_name: 35 U.S.C. -- Patents (as reproduced in MPEP Appendix L)
sources.issuing_organization: Office of the Law Revision Counsel / reproduced by USPTO
sources.version: Current as of January 31, 2024 (per in-document editor's note)
sources.retrieval_date: 2025-08-18 (pre-existing, part of the MPEP acquisition -- see EXAM-1)
sources.notes: Deliberately using the MPEP-bundled snapshot (dated exactly to the tested MPEP edition) rather than pulling live current USC text from uscode.house.gov. This avoids inadvertently validating/invalidating exam content against statutory amendments that postdate the tested MPEP edition. Supporting/validation source only -- does not expand exam scope per Source Policy.

sources.source_name: 37 CFR -- Patents, Trademarks, and Copyrights (as reproduced in MPEP Appendix R, Consolidated Patent Rules)
sources.issuing_organization: Office of the Federal Register / reproduced by USPTO
sources.version: Current as of January 31, 2024 (per in-document editor's note)
sources.retrieval_date: 2025-08-18 (pre-existing, part of the MPEP acquisition -- see EXAM-1)
sources.notes: Same rationale as SUPPORT-3: the MPEP-bundled snapshot is used deliberately instead of live current 37 CFR from ecfr.gov, to stay pinned to the tested edition's rule text. The MPEP build spec for Appendix R itself notes USPTO periodically updates a separate 'Consolidated Rules' PDF between MPEP publications -- that live document is NOT used here for the same reason. Supporting/validation source only.

open_items_for_next_session: Manually review Prometric tutorial (SUPPORT-2) in a browser and write a short internal description of the interface for later use in the practice-exam UI design (Phase 4).

Phase 2 will require locating and acquiring the historical USPTO exam question/answer corpus (1997-2003 sessions) -- preliminary research found USPTO's original hosting pattern at uspto.gov/ip/boards/oed/exam/past/ (no longer live) with at least 2002-2003 AM/PM sessions recoverable via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine; full year coverage (1997-2001) not yet confirmed. This is explicitly out of scope for Phase 1.
